01 · Before us

The page had reach it had bought, and no engine to earn any.

  • No dedicated focus on Instagram. Content was repurposed from YouTube.
  • Multiple faces on the page, so the audience never learned who Expert Panel was.
  • 6,000 to 13,000 views per reel, engagement flat.
One face, appearing again and again, compounds. Recognition becomes trust, and trust is what makes someone stop scrolling.

03 · What we overcame

The delay was never the writing.

Fifteen scripts went out on the 1st and came back written by the 4th. The two weeks then disappeared into approval, shooting and edit.

Assumed causeScripting

The visible step, so the one everyone looked at first.

→
Actual causeApproval & shoot

Fixed with a dedicated shooter, batched shoot days, and approval moved upstream.

03 · Compliance

The biggest problem we hit, and it cost us live posts.

The post

An RBI licence reel

The opening line stated, as fact, that you no longer needed to repay your loan.

The objection

It was not true

Expert Panel stops illegal harassment. Recovery is the lender’s legal right. That claim reaches a regulator.

The cost

Posts pulled after going live

Three to four from the first batch, two to three archived later. One had already crossed 160,000 views.

The reach and the risk came from the same sentence. That is what made it hard to fix.
10 / 23
03 · Compliance

What we built so it stopped happening.

The written standard
  • A checklist every video runs before it goes out
  • Five hard prohibitions, shared with the whole team
  • Never guarantee a score recovery or a timeline
  • Never name the lender
The craft fix
  • Frame the claim as true-or-false, not as a statement
  • Or state the myth, then debunk it
  • Carry the question mark in the on-screen text, so the spoken hook keeps its pull
The process fix
  • Approval moved to the scripting stage
  • Topics approved before a script is written
  • A four-stage approval chain client-side
  • Legal review added from July
First batch3–4

videos pulled after they were already live

→
Since the checklist1

one removed, none since the process moved upstream

04 · How we trained the team

We did not hand over a document. We taught, then watched them do it.

1 · We wrote the rules
  • Colour-coded script format
  • 130 to 150 words per script
  • Three genuinely different hooks
  • Text hooks of four to six words
2 · We wrote an example of every format
  • A full worked script per format
  • Because the team had never written one
  • Plus a brief explaining when to use which
3 · We sat with them
  • Line-by-line review of their own drafts
  • A dedicated call to train the editors
  • An editing guideline with EP’s brand rules
Within two weeks the rules were being applied unprompted. That is capability, not delivery.

07 · Trial reels

Every reel is tested before it is published.

How it runs
  • Three variations of the same reel, unlisted
  • Posted at least an hour apart
  • Judged after 24 to 72 hours
How the winner is picked
  • Average watch time is the primary signal
  • Then reach, saves and shares
  • Tie-break on highest reach
Scale
  • 58 variations run across 30 batches
  • Only the winner goes to the main feed
19 / 23
07 · Trial reels

Instagram tightened enforcement. We adapted.

Duplicate detection began suppressing variations that differed by only one line of dialogue. Earlier we could get away with it, and then we could not.

The fix is now standing procedure in EP’s editing guideline. Apply two to three changes per variation: zoom and swap a B-roll shot, change the track, add 10% speed, nudge the caption position.
